name: 折りたたみ操作と区切り
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0014 折りたたみ操作と区切り.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact collapse action and divider from source region18,548,354,60 normalized. Exact single text 閉じる, ordinary Meiryo REGULAR400 logical12px/16px, tracking0. Center a small upward chevron immediately left of 閉じる as one centered action group. ORIGINAL chevron controls shape: a short shallow symmetrical upward angle of two equal connected strokes, not the mock's tall narrow caret/roof. Match source small optical size, stroke weight and compact icon-to-label gap; use slate#526173 glyph, ink text. Below the centered action, a fine neutral horizontal divider spans logical354px width with source's restrained vertical gap. Pure-white canvas, no button fill, no enclosing card, no gradient or extra accent; no other labels, rows, phone or controls. Uniform enlargement into readable wide1536x512 composition with restrained white margin. Preserve expanded-state upward chevron direction and exact divider placement.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No accent needed: upward chevron and label communicate collapse. Use consistent slate/ink with fine neutral divider and pure white.
reviewNotes: 原版/crop/mock目視。mockの細長いcaretを原版の浅い上向きchevronへ修正。無彩色の開閉操作なのでaccent不要。生成後に閉じる文字、上向きglyph、中央group、下部divider、白背景を確認。操作/font同一性/native編集/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
